Each identity signs in in its own Playwright Chromium context: Daniel Okafor (Administrator) and Nadia Haddad (Legal Team Member) by password; Jonas Weber (Business User) by a fresh magic link read from the lab Mailpit.

Reviewer-created records named DOC-030 admin-config V-C38 <thing> <stamp>: Matter, Contract, Entity and Knowledge types; Contract and Matter Statuses; Matter, Contract and Entity Fields; a fixed-term NDA-style Contract type; Officer roles. API fixtures (Administrator session) only for records that use a definition: Matters on a type or Status, two Officers (one resigned) on a role, and one Contract Text Field. Records retaining values: a Contract created in the browser holds a value for a Field that is later archived and restored.
scenarios.expected: Types, Statuses, Fields, Form Rows, Branches and Officer roles configure as documented; archive reassignment moves records onto a live replacement only; the Default type refuses archive with a reason; archived Fields keep their stored values for restoration; new records follow the Form's requiredness and Branches; Stage and Category cannot change; non-Administrators cannot edit configuration.
scenarios.actual: 36 recorded browser steps passed as Daniel Okafor, plus two API refusals. Types: Add type with Save and Cancel, Rename, Edit (Details and Form) with the Description saved on blur, arrow-key reorder, on Matters, Contracts, Entities and Knowledge (Knowledge rows have no Edit). Archiving a type used by one Matter showed the usage count and offered only live types other than itself (no archived type); the Matter moved to the replacement and stayed there after Show archived > Restore. The Default Contract and Matter types (no label) show Archive; the dialog refused with "Default is the Default type and cannot be archived or deleted: module-only Requests need its Form." Create matter preselected Default. Document types: Settings > Documents lists Matters, Contracts and Entities; Add type, Rename and reorder saved; the six fixed Contract types show "<name> is fixed. Contract workflows depend on it." with no Rename or Archive; an added Entity type appeared in the Entity Upload dialog's Type choice, its Archive asked for no replacement and it left the choice until Restore. Statuses: Contract Add status with a Stage (Save status, Cancel), no Stage control on the row, Draft/Active/Expired locked, an in-use Status's dialog reads "Move them to another status first" with Archive disabled; Matter Add status defaulted the group to In progress, a Closed Status has no group, a row group change persisted, Open and Closed are locked, and archiving an in-use custom Status offered only Open-Category replacements and moved the Matter. Fields: Default Fields starts collapsed with locked rows above an expanded Custom Fields; Governing law, Jurisdiction and Our position show "is a default Field and can't be archived" (API archive 409); Add field offers the ten Types, Options one per line, no Yes/No control for Boolean, no reorder handles, no Type control on Edit ("The field type is immutable after creation."); Contract Text and Long text show AI prompt and Answer style (Organisation default), User and Entity show no AI prompt. Form: Title and Type pinned with "Position and switches are fixed"; Attach Field lists Fields alphabetically with Search fields; Create Field attaches from the Form; each switch change showed Saved; On intake form turned on and locked Visible on Portal ("Turn off On intake form first"); Touchpoint moved Intake -> Creation -> Record with the switches; a User Row on intake could not be required; arrow-key Row moves persisted and stopped below Type. Branch: Add condition in the header added a Branch at the end of the Form; Term type / is / Fixed saved as "Show when all of: Term type is Fixed"; the grip's Put under a condition… moved Expiry date under it; Preview intake form ("Preview only. No Request will be sent.") showed Expiry date as required for Fixed and hid it for Evergreen, and Submit request refused the missing answer; Add another condition asked AND or OR, Join conditions changed it, an unfinished Branch disabled Add condition, Escape discarded it, Remove condition kept Expiry date at the root. Records: Create contract refused an empty Required for creation Field ("Fill … — this contract type requires it."), asked Expiry date only for Fixed, and created a Contract whose Fields tab shows the value; archiving the Field hid it from the Form and the record while the API kept the value; Restore brought the Row and the value back; Detach removed a Row and kept the Field. Entity Forms show only Required for creation and no Preview. Officer roles (Director & Officer roles): Add role, Rename, reorder; archiving a role used by one current and one resigned Officer counted 2 and moved both; Restore did not move them back; Other is locked.

API refusal checks made with Daniel Okafor's own session, because the browser offers no control for these choices.
scenarios.expected: Invalid reassignment (onto an archived type or onto the type itself) and a Stage or Category change on an existing Status are refused.
scenarios.actual: As the Administrator, POST /api/v1/matter-types/{"DOC-030 admin-config V-C38 Replacement type 0925133420"}/archive with reassignToId = the archived "DOC-030 admin-config V-C38 Archived probe type 0925133420" answered 400 "The reassignment target must be a live matter type."; with reassignToId = itself answered 400 "A type can't take reassignments from itself.". The type stayed live (archivedAt null). As the Administrator, PATCH /api/v1/contract-statuses/{"DOC-030 admin-config V-C38 Contract status renamed 0925112257"} with stage "ended" answered 400 "One or more request fields are invalid."; the Status keeps Stage "review". PATCH /api/v1/matter-statuses/{"DOC-030 admin-config V-C38 Matter status waiting 0925112257"} with category "closed" answered 400 "One or more request fields are invalid.". In the browser the archive dialog never offers these targets and neither Statuses page has a Stage or Category control, as the guide says.
